en.headline: 22 commits on 2026-10-17: codemap docs, activity-card fix, MiMo issue triage
en.summary: On 2026-10-17 the user made **22 own commits** plus 30 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`, with no pull requests and no reviews. `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` accounted for 17 own commits: initializing a repository codemap (per-directory maps, a root Atlas, AGENTS.md registration), documenting the mapping baseline and its staleness check, and moving that baseline to the activity-card fix. On the same repo, the activity card was switched to a +08 natural-day window restricted to public data, the AI retry path now doubles `max_tokens` when a 200 response carries empty content, and `docs/summary.html` was re-rendered with per-repo count pills; the `repo-overview.excalidraw` sketch was redrawn as a three-question matrix. `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` got 3 commits: the version badge is derived from `SKILL.md` with a drift check, `discover-agents` emits the full inventory record and reports skipped built-ins, and snapshot writes are atomic with loud failure on unreadable snapshots. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` got 2 doc commits correcting stale conclusions on subcommands, bundled skills and Windows ports, and adding remote-branch-deletion checks.

zh.headline: 2026-10-17 共 22 次提交：codemap 文档、活动卡片修复、MiMo 问题跟进
zh.summary: 2026-10-17 本人提交 **22 次**，另有 30 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，当日无 PR、无评审。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 占 17 次本人提交：初始化仓库 codemap（分目录映射、根 Atlas、AGENTS.md 注册），记录映射基线及其过期判断方法，并把基线推进到活动卡片修复。同一仓库还把活动卡片改为 +08 自然日窗口并只统计公开数据；AI 调用在返回 200 但 content 为空时也翻倍 `max_tokens` 重试；`docs/summary.html` 重新渲染，按仓库板块补上条数 pill；`repo-overview.excalidraw` 草图重画为「三问矩阵」。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 有 3 次提交：版本徽章改为由 `SKILL.md` 推导并检查版本漂移，`discover-agents` 输出完整清单并报告跳过的内置项，快照写入改为原子操作、快照不可读时显式失败。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 有 2 次文档提交：修正子命令列表、随包 skill 数量与 Windows 端口方面的过期结论，补充远程分支删除的检查与风险。issue 方面共 5 条活动，均在 `anomalyco/opencode`：在 #50823（单会话 ≥5 张图后读到过期图片）下评论，在 #56113（子代理报 `model_coming_soon`）下两次评论，并在 #55785（Go 端点对图片一律返回 400）下评论后将其关闭。当日无发布、无讨论、无新星标，各板块均未触及采集上限。
